name: Talon of Tethis
summary: The Talon of Tethis is proof of a hunt in Stranglethorn Vale. Hemet Nesingwary asks you to bring it back after defeating the elusive raptor.

sections.title: A Hunter’s Proof
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary names Tethis as a raptor few hunters can claim to have slain. Bring him the talon, and he calls you a master raptor slayer.

faq.q: What is the Talon of Tethis?
faq.answer: The Talon of Tethis is proof that you defeated the raptor Tethis for Hemet Nesingwary.
Hemet Nesingwary wants Tethis's talon as proof of the hunt.
Tethis wanders around the Gurubashi Arena, mainly to its north.

faq.q: Why does Hemet want the talon?
faq.answer: Hemet asks for the talon as proof that you killed Tethis, a raptor he has failed to bring down himself.

angles.text: As a hunter, Hemet's challenge tests your skill against Tethis, a raptor he has failed to kill.
